title: Forge Retail
description: This mod introduces new tools, a new forging system and an economy system.
body:
this is the Forge Retail mod! With this mod you can sell items and make tools to get materials faster. The mod adds new ores, new tools and a completly new forging system. To make the new tools you need to melt materials, make casts, cast parts then you can craft the new tools.

# Crafting
To make tools, read these:
1. workstations
2. melting
3. cast making
4. casting
5. last steps

# Workstations:
1. Melting Station
2. Cast maker
3. Casting station

# Melting:
To melt materials you need meltable materials, a bucket and some coal.
Meltable materials:
- Gold
- Iron
- Copper
- Sapphire

Steps:
1. Put any meltable materials, coal and bucket into the melting machine
2. Press the button

# Cast making:
To make casts you need a **Cast maker**, **Molten gold** and a stone tool part.
Steps:
1. Craft a Cast maker
2. Craft a stone tool part (any type)
3. Put the stone tool part into the Cast Maker
4. Press the button

# Casting:
To make the final tool parts you need the **Casting station** and the tool materials.

Tool materials:
- Molten iron (for handle only)
- Molten copper (for handle only)
- Molten sapphire (for head only)

Steps:
1. Put the one of the casts and a tool material into the casting station
2. Press the button

# Last steps:
To make the final tool parts you need a tool head and a copper handle (iron handle tools is in the next update).

Steps:
1. Craft together a sapphire tool head and a copper handle
2. Done

# Items:
1. Molds (ingot, pickaxe head, axe head, shovel head)
2. Sapphire juice: a drink item that gives you effects
3. Beanie: cosmetic item

# Selling:
To open the selling gui press **F**.

Steps:
1. Put the product in the first slot
2. Set a price
3. Press the button

# Installation:

This mod is in 1.20.1 forge client and server.
